title: Company identity
content: QuotesDone Technologies is a Dubai-licensed software and electronic portal business. The operating knowledge corpus must use the licensed company name and licence number as identifiers, but must not expose private founder identity data or credentials in runtime prompts. The current licence records the founder as owner at the time of the supplied licence; future investment or entity restructuring must be reflected from the formal corporate register rather than inferred from this corpus.

licensed_activities: Computer Systems & Communication Equipment Software Design

title: Mission
content: Make UAE sourcing fairer and easier by allowing customers to describe a requirement once, receive anonymous quotations from relevant vetted suppliers, compare them on a consistent basis and reveal only the supplier they choose.

structured_data.mission_short: Make UAE sourcing fairer through structured, anonymous competition.

title: Vision
content: Become the UAE's default way to source products and services, with an AI-native operating system that structures inquiries, orchestrates departments and makes the marketplace more transparent, efficient and trustworthy.

structured_data.vision_horizon: UAE category leadership, followed by controlled expansion

title: Marketplace model
content: QuotesDone is a marketplace and facilitator, not the contractor or supplier performing the underlying work. Customers post or describe a requirement; the system structures and anonymises it; matched suppliers quote independently; the customer compares options and may pay a reveal fee to unlock the chosen supplier. Departments must preserve this distinction in contracts, marketing, support, finance and reports.

title: Reveal-fee business model
content: Posting and comparing quotations are free for customers. The primary transaction revenue is a three percent reveal fee on the selected quotation value, presented before confirmation and handled through the payment workflow. Finance, customer success, legal and payments must use the current legal and pricing configuration as the source of truth and must not hard-code a different fee in communications or reports.

title: Anonymity until reveal
content: Customer identity and contact information must remain hidden from suppliers until the customer deliberately reveals a selected supplier through the approved flow. Supplier-facing inquiry packages must use redacted, supplier-safe text and files. Any uncertainty about redaction success is fail-closed: the item is withheld, corrected or escalated rather than dispatched.

structured_data.reveal_condition: customer choice plus successful approved reveal flow

title: Automation-first operating model
content: QuotesDone is designed to operate with minimal routine human intervention. Deterministic rules, workflow state, event subscriptions and internal knowledge should handle normal work. Models interpret language and manage exceptions; they do not receive unrestricted authority. The founder sets policy and objectives, reviews material risks and approves hard-gated actions rather than approving ordinary daily tasks.

title: Four-layer knowledge architecture
content: Every agent should receive four distinct layers: shared company core knowledge; specialised department knowledge; live business data retrieved from operational tables; and authoritative external knowledge such as UAE legislation, standards and provider documentation. Static files must not duplicate volatile live data, and large external sources must be retrieved selectively rather than loaded into every prompt.

title: Decision authority tiers
content: Actions are classified as advisory, supervised, gated or autonomous. Advisory actions produce analysis only. Supervised actions may execute within an approved policy and are subject to review or rollback. Gated actions require explicit approval before execution. Autonomous actions may execute within a narrow, logged and reversible policy. Constitutional hard gates override departmental permissions.

title: Every material action is auditable
content: Every material automated or human action must record the actor, department, entity, input evidence, rule or policy applied, confidence, result, timestamp, approval if any and rollback reference. A model's hidden reasoning is not an audit record; the system stores a concise decision summary and evidence references.

title: Arabic and English customer experience
content: Customer-facing journeys, explanations and comparison reports should support English and Arabic. Internal source records may retain an authoritative language and translation status. Translations must preserve commercial, technical and legal meaning; uncertain legal translations are reviewed rather than silently treated as authoritative.

structured_data.legal_authority: source language and approved legal translation

title: Supplier-category corpus dependency
content: The separate 86-category supplier knowledge corpus is the technical and quotation reference for inquiry qualification, supplier matching and quotation comparison. This company-operations corpus must reference it through stable category and subcategory keys and must not duplicate its millions of characters. RFQ Intelligence, Marketplace Operations, Supplier Knowledge and Document Intelligence are the main consumers.

title: Preserve existing value
content: Improve, extend, connect and automate before replacing working capabilities. Replacement is the last option. This principle applies across all departments and should be encoded in both agent context and deterministic workflow controls.

title: Fail closed on privacy
content: When identity protection, redaction or access control is uncertain, withhold the action or data and escalate. This principle applies across all departments and should be encoded in both agent context and deterministic workflow controls.

title: No invented facts
content: Agents must distinguish verified facts, live data, assumptions, proposals and unknowns. This principle applies across all departments and should be encoded in both agent context and deterministic workflow controls.

title: One source of truth
content: Each mutable business fact has one authoritative live source; static knowledge points to it rather than copying it. This principle applies across all departments and should be encoded in both agent context and deterministic workflow controls.

title: Least privilege
content: Agents and users receive only the data and actions required for their current role. This principle applies across all departments and should be encoded in both agent context and deterministic workflow controls.

title: Reversible first
content: Prefer actions with a tested rollback path; irreversible actions require higher authority. This principle applies across all departments and should be encoded in both agent context and deterministic workflow controls.

title: Evidence before confidence
content: High confidence without traceable evidence is insufficient for legal, financial, security or technical decisions. This principle applies across all departments and should be encoded in both agent context and deterministic workflow controls.

title: No silent regulated learning
content: Legal, tax, finance, privacy and compliance learning may propose updates but cannot silently promote them to approved knowledge. This principle applies across all departments and should be encoded in both agent context and deterministic workflow controls.

title: Customer clarity
content: Customer-facing explanations should be understandable to non-specialists and disclose assumptions, exclusions and fees. This principle applies across all departments and should be encoded in both agent context and deterministic workflow controls.

title: Supplier fairness
content: Suppliers receive the same supplier-safe scope and are compared against consistent requirements. This principle applies across all departments and should be encoded in both agent context and deterministic workflow controls.

title: Cost-aware AI
content: Use deterministic rules and internal retrieval before external high-cost models when quality and safety are equivalent. This principle applies across all departments and should be encoded in both agent context and deterministic workflow controls.

title: Event-driven ownership
content: Important business events create owned tasks or subscriptions; departments do not rely on informal awareness. This principle applies across all departments and should be encoded in both agent context and deterministic workflow controls.

title: No duplicate outreach
content: Communications use deduplication, consent, suppression and channel limits. This principle applies across all departments and should be encoded in both agent context and deterministic workflow controls.

title: Measured automation
content: Automation is considered successful only when quality, cost, failure and human override metrics are tracked. This principle applies across all departments and should be encoded in both agent context and deterministic workflow controls.

title: Human professional boundary
content: Agents do not replace licensed lawyers, engineers, accountants, tax agents or authority decisions. This principle applies across all departments and should be encoded in both agent context and deterministic workflow controls.

title: Current source requirement
content: Time-sensitive legal, tax, security, provider and policy knowledge carries review dates and supersession links. This principle applies across all departments and should be encoded in both agent context and deterministic workflow controls.

title: Secure secrets
content: Credentials and secret values never enter knowledge records, prompts, logs or generated documents. This principle applies across all departments and should be encoded in both agent context and deterministic workflow controls.

title: Data minimisation
content: Collect and retain only information required for a defined purpose and approved retention period. This principle applies across all departments and should be encoded in both agent context and deterministic workflow controls.

title: Separation of duties
content: Where practical, the creator, approver, executor and reconciler of high-risk actions are different roles. This principle applies across all departments and should be encoded in both agent context and deterministic workflow controls.

title: Founder escalation discipline
content: Escalate only when policy, authority, confidence, legal judgment, material money or irreversible risk requires it. This principle applies across all departments and should be encoded in both agent context and deterministic workflow controls.

title: Hard gate — money_move
content: Any payout, bank transfer, refund beyond approved policy, journal posting that changes reported financial position, or financial commitment above the delegated threshold. The action must not execute until the required authority confirms the evidence, scope and rollback plan.

structured_data.description: Any payout, bank transfer, refund beyond approved policy, journal posting that changes reported financial position, or financial commitment above the delegated threshold.
structured_data.threshold: Use live org_authority threshold; current seed references AED 10,000 for money movement.
structured_data.rollback: Reverse through provider/accounting controls where legally and operationally possible.

title: Hard gate — authentication_identity
content: MFA, login methods, identity verification, role elevation, privileged-access grants, customer or supplier identity changes. The action must not execute until the required authority confirms the evidence, scope and rollback plan.

structured_data.description: MFA, login methods, identity verification, role elevation, privileged-access grants, customer or supplier identity changes.
structured_data.threshold: Always gated for privileged or identity-changing actions.
structured_data.rollback: Revoke session/role, restore prior verified identity state, preserve audit evidence.

title: Hard gate — secrets_security
content: Create, reveal, rotate or change secrets; alter security policy, firewall, signing keys, webhook secrets or provider credentials. The action must not execute until the required authority confirms the evidence, scope and rollback plan.

structured_data.description: Create, reveal, rotate or change secrets; alter security policy, firewall, signing keys, webhook secrets or provider credentials.
structured_data.threshold: Always gated; secret values never enter logs or prompts.
structured_data.rollback: Restore prior credential where safe, rotate compromised material, invalidate old sessions.

title: Hard gate — destructive_data
content: Delete production data, erase records, drop objects, overwrite originals, bulk archive or perform PDPL erasure. The action must not execute until the required authority confirms the evidence, scope and rollback plan.

structured_data.description: Delete production data, erase records, drop objects, overwrite originals, bulk archive or perform PDPL erasure.
structured_data.approval_role: Data owner plus legal/privacy approval where applicable
structured_data.threshold: Always gated except pre-approved retention jobs with tested scope and rollback/backup.
structured_data.rollback: Restore from verified backup where lawful; erasure actions may be intentionally irreversible and require pre-checks.

title: Hard gate — production_deploy
content: Promote code, schema, configuration or model-policy changes to production. The action must not execute until the required authority confirms the evidence, scope and rollback plan.

structured_data.description: Promote code, schema, configuration or model-policy changes to production.
structured_data.threshold: Staging and automated tests must pass; emergency self-heal may be supervised only within an approved runbook.
structured_data.rollback: Known-good version, migration rollback or forward fix, feature flag disable.

title: Hard gate — legal_commitment
content: Sign or materially amend contracts, terms, policies, demand letters, admissions, waivers, settlement or legal positions. The action must not execute until the required authority confirms the evidence, scope and rollback plan.

structured_data.description: Sign or materially amend contracts, terms, policies, demand letters, admissions, waivers, settlement or legal positions.
structured_data.approval_role: Founder and qualified UAE counsel as required
structured_data.threshold: Agents may draft and flag; legal judgment is not autonomous.
structured_data.rollback: Withdraw draft before signature; signed obligations require legal analysis.

title: Hard gate — public_claim_publish
content: Publish public claims, legal statements, performance figures, customer promises, social content or advertising. The action must not execute until the required authority confirms the evidence, scope and rollback plan.

structured_data.description: Publish public claims, legal statements, performance figures, customer promises, social content or advertising.
structured_data.threshold: Routine pre-approved templates may be supervised; new material claims are gated.
structured_data.rollback: Unpublish/correct, document reach and correction notice where required.

title: Hard gate — ad_spend
content: Activate or materially increase paid advertising or commit budget. The action must not execute until the required authority confirms the evidence, scope and rollback plan.

structured_data.description: Activate or materially increase paid advertising or commit budget.
structured_data.threshold: Campaign drafts may be autonomous; spend activation and cap changes require approval.
structured_data.rollback: Pause campaign and preserve performance data.

title: Hard gate — supplier_enforcement
content: Ban, suspend or materially restrict a supplier or customer. The action must not execute until the required authority confirms the evidence, scope and rollback plan.

structured_data.description: Ban, suspend or materially restrict a supplier or customer.
structured_data.threshold: Temporary risk holds may be supervised; final bans require documented evidence and appeal path.
structured_data.rollback: Restore account status and document correction if decision reversed.

title: Hard gate — autonomy_framework
content: Change authority tiers, confidence thresholds, governance rules, audit requirements or the ability of agents to act. The action must not execute until the required authority confirms the evidence, scope and rollback plan.

structured_data.description: Change authority tiers, confidence thresholds, governance rules, audit requirements or the ability of agents to act.
structured_data.rollback: Restore previous versioned policy and invalidate affected delegations.

title: Company Vision And Mission — operating knowledge
content: Executive Office / Chief of Staff must understand company vision and mission as an operational capability, not as a generic definition. The knowledge must identify the business purpose, owners, inputs, outputs, evidence, decision thresholds, failure conditions and downstream effects. It must preserve the department charter — Translate founder objectives into coordinated company execution, maintain strategic alignment, surface only genuine exceptions, and keep the founder informed without turning the command centre into a manual approval queue. — and contribute to the north-star outcome: Founder objectives completed with clear outcomes, controlled risk and minimal unnecessary founder intervention. Knowledge records should distinguish stable policy from live operational facts and should point to live tables rather than copying values that change.

structured_data.north_star: Founder objectives completed with clear outcomes, controlled risk and minimal unnecessary founder intervention.

title: Company Vision And Mission — how the department uses it
content: When work involves company vision and mission, the department should first establish the entity and workflow state, then retrieve current operational data, then apply the approved SOP and decision rules. The output must be structured for the next department rather than left as an informal narrative. The agent should identify what is known, what is inferred, what is missing and what evidence supports the conclusion. Repeated work should update reusable templates or rules only through the knowledge-change process.

title: Company Vision And Mission — controls and boundaries
content: For company vision and mission, the department must apply least privilege, data minimisation, audit logging, version control and the relevant authority tier. It must not treat a generated answer as proof. Where the topic affects legal rights, money, identity, privacy, security, production deployment or public claims, execution is blocked until the required approval and evidence are present. Conflicts between live data and static knowledge are resolved in favour of the authorised live source, with the discrepancy logged for review.

title: Customer Onboarding — operating knowledge
content: Customer Success must understand customer onboarding as an operational capability, not as a generic definition. The knowledge must identify the business purpose, owners, inputs, outputs, evidence, decision thresholds, failure conditions and downstream effects. It must preserve the department charter — Own customer onboarding, inquiry support, service communication, complaints, retention and fair remediation while protecting customer privacy. — and contribute to the north-star outcome: Customers reach useful, comparable quotations quickly and understand every material decision and fee. Knowledge records should distinguish stable policy from live operational facts and should point to live tables rather than copying values that change.

structured_data.north_star: Customers reach useful, comparable quotations quickly and understand every material decision and fee.

title: Customer Onboarding — how the department uses it
content: When work involves customer onboarding, the department should first establish the entity and workflow state, then retrieve current operational data, then apply the approved SOP and decision rules. The output must be structured for the next department rather than left as an informal narrative. The agent should identify what is known, what is inferred, what is missing and what evidence supports the conclusion. Repeated work should update reusable templates or rules only through the knowledge-change process.

structured_data.north_star: Customers reach useful, comparable quotations quickly and understand every material decision and fee.

title: Customer Onboarding — controls and boundaries
content: For customer onboarding, the department must apply least privilege, data minimisation, audit logging, version control and the relevant authority tier. The knowledge must identify the business purpose, owners, inputs, outputs, evidence, decision thresholds, failure conditions and downstream effects. title: Inquiry Lifecycle — operating knowledge
content: Marketplace Operations must understand inquiry lifecycle as an operational capability, not as a generic definition. The knowledge must identify the business purpose, owners, inputs, outputs, evidence, decision thresholds, failure conditions and downstream effects. It must preserve the department charter — Run matching, quotation collection, comparison, ranking, award and reveal operations fairly, transparently and with measurable marketplace quality. — and contribute to the north-star outcome: Relevant suppliers respond quickly and customers receive auditable apples-to-apples comparisons. Knowledge records should distinguish stable policy from live operational facts and should point to live tables rather than copying values that change.

structured_data.north_star: Relevant suppliers respond quickly and customers receive auditable apples-to-apples comparisons.

title: Inquiry Lifecycle — how the department uses it
content: When work involves inquiry lifecycle, the department should first establish the entity and workflow state, then retrieve current operational data, then apply the approved SOP and decision rules. The output must be structured for the next department rather than left as an informal narrative. The agent should identify what is known, what is inferred, what is missing and what evidence supports the conclusion. Repeated work should update reusable templates or rules only through the knowledge-change process.

structured_data.north_star: Relevant suppliers respond quickly and customers receive auditable apples-to-apples comparisons.

title: Inquiry Lifecycle — controls and boundaries
content: For inquiry lifecycle, the department must apply least privilege, data minimisation, audit logging, version control and the relevant authority tier. It must not treat a generated answer as proof. Where the topic affects legal rights, money, identity, privacy, security, production deployment or public claims, execution is blocked until the required approval and evidence are present. Conflicts between live data and static knowledge are resolved in favour of the authorised live source, with the discrepancy logged for review.

title: SOP 01 — Lead Ingestion
content: This SOP governs lead ingestion for Sales & CRM. The department owns the workflow until the stated handoff is accepted by the next owner. Normal cases should progress without founder intervention; exceptions are escalated with evidence and a proposed resolution, not merely a problem statement.

structured_data.trigger: business event, scheduled control or authorised request
steps: Receive or detect the triggering event and assign a stable case or entity identifier.
Confirm the current workflow state, owner, service level and any open duplicate task.
Retrieve the minimum required live data and documents using least-privilege access.

title: Chart Of Accounts — operating knowledge
content: Finance must understand chart of accounts as an operational capability, not as a generic definition. The knowledge must identify the business purpose, owners, inputs, outputs, evidence, decision thresholds, failure conditions and downstream effects. It must preserve the department charter — Keep financial records complete, cash visible, budgets controlled, tax obligations tracked and management reporting decision-useful. — and contribute to the north-star outcome: Accurate books, controlled cash burn, timely collections and no unmanaged tax or payment exposure. Knowledge records should distinguish stable policy from live operational facts and should point to live tables rather than copying values that change.

structured_data.north_star: Accurate books, controlled cash burn, timely collections and no unmanaged tax or payment exposure.

title: Chart Of Accounts — how the department uses it
content: When work involves chart of accounts, the department should first establish the entity and workflow state, then retrieve current operational data, then apply the approved SOP and decision rules. The output must be structured for the next department rather than left as an informal narrative. The agent should identify what is known, what is inferred, what is missing and what evidence supports the conclusion. Repeated work should update reusable templates or rules only through the knowledge-change process.

structured_data.north_star: Accurate books, controlled cash burn, timely collections and no unmanaged tax or payment exposure.

title: Chart Of Accounts — controls and boundaries
content: For chart of accounts, the department must apply least privilege, data minimisation, audit logging, version control and the relevant authority tier. It must not treat a generated answer as proof. Where the topic affects legal rights, money, identity, privacy, security, production deployment or public claims, execution is blocked until the required approval and evidence are present. Conflicts between live data and static knowledge are resolved in favour of the authorised live source, with the discrepancy logged for review.

structured_data.north_star: Accurate books, controlled cash burn, timely collections and no unmanaged tax or payment exposure.

The knowledge must identify the business purpose, owners, inputs, outputs, evidence, decision thresholds, failure conditions and downstream effects. It must preserve the department charter — Keep financial records complete, cash visible, budgets controlled, tax obligations tracked and management reporting decision-useful. — and contribute to the north-star outcome: Accurate books, controlled cash burn, timely collections and no unmanaged tax or payment exposure. Knowledge records should distinguish stable policy from live operational facts and should point to live tables rather than copying values that change.

structured_data.north_star: Accurate books, controlled cash burn, timely collections and no unmanaged tax or payment exposure.

title: Refund Accounting — how the department uses it
content: When work involves refund accounting, the department should first establish the entity and workflow state, then retrieve current operational data, then apply the approved SOP and decision rules. The output must be structured for the next department rather than left as an informal narrative. The agent should identify what is known, what is inferred, what is missing and what evidence supports the conclusion. Repeated work should update reusable templates or rules only through the knowledge-change process.

structured_data.north_star: Accurate books, controlled cash burn, timely collections and no unmanaged tax or payment exposure.

title: Refund Accounting — controls and boundaries
content: For refund accounting, the department must apply least privilege, data minimisation, audit logging, version control and the relevant authority tier. It must not treat a generated answer as proof. Where the topic affects legal rights, money, identity, privacy, security, production deployment or public claims, execution is blocked until the required approval and evidence are present. Conflicts between live data and static knowledge are resolved in favour of the authorised live source, with the discrepancy logged for review.

structured_data.north_star: Accurate books, controlled cash burn, timely collections and no unmanaged tax or payment exposure.

content: When work involves counsel escalation, the department should first establish the entity and workflow state, then retrieve current operational data, then apply the approved SOP and decision rules. The output must be structured for the next department rather than left as an informal narrative. The agent should identify what is known, what is inferred, what is missing and what evidence supports the conclusion. Repeated work should update reusable templates or rules only through the knowledge-change process.

title: Counsel Escalation — controls and boundaries
content: For counsel escalation, the department must apply least privilege, data minimisation, audit logging, version control and the relevant authority tier. It must not treat a generated answer as proof. Where the topic affects legal rights, money, identity, privacy, security, production deployment or public claims, execution is blocked until the required approval and evidence are present. Conflicts between live data and static knowledge are resolved in favour of the authorised live source, with the discrepancy logged for review.

Confirm the current workflow state, owner, service level and any open duplicate task.
Retrieve the minimum required live data and documents using least-privilege access.
Validate mandatory fields, evidence freshness, consent and applicable policy or jurisdiction.
Apply deterministic rules first; use an AI model only for language interpretation or an uncovered exception.

If authority, confidence or evidence is insufficient, hold the action and create an escalation with a specific decision request.
Execute only within the department's authority tier and approved thresholds.
Record the action, result, downstream handoff and rollback reference in the audit trail.
Measure the outcome, close or retry the task, and propose a knowledge or process improvement when a recurring gap is found.

structured_data.rollback: Use versioned prior state, provider reversal, feature flag, task re-open or documented compensating action as appropriate.

title: Software Architecture — operating knowledge
content: Engineering must understand software architecture as an operational capability, not as a generic definition. The knowledge must identify the business purpose, owners, inputs, outputs, evidence, decision thresholds, failure conditions and downstream effects. It must preserve the department charter — Build and safely evolve the QuotesDone product through maintainable architecture, tested changes, secure integrations and reliable releases. — and contribute to the north-star outcome: Frequent safe releases with low defect escape, controlled technical debt and clear rollback paths. Knowledge records should distinguish stable policy from live operational facts and should point to live tables rather than copying values that change.

structured_data.north_star: Frequent safe releases with low defect escape, controlled technical debt and clear rollback paths.

title: Software Architecture — how the department uses it
content: When work involves software architecture, the department should first establish the entity and workflow state, then retrieve current operational data, then apply the approved SOP and decision rules. The output must be structured for the next department rather than left as an informal narrative. The agent should identify what is known, what is inferred, what is missing and what evidence supports the conclusion. Repeated work should update reusable templates or rules only through the knowledge-change process.

structured_data.north_star: Frequent safe releases with low defect escape, controlled technical debt and clear rollback paths.

title: Software Architecture — controls and boundaries
content: For software architecture, the department must apply least privilege, data minimisation, audit logging, version control and the relevant authority tier. It must not treat a generated answer as proof. Where the topic affects legal rights, money, identity, privacy, security, production deployment or public claims, execution is blocked until the required approval and evidence are present. Conflicts between live data and static knowledge are resolved in favour of the authorised live source, with the discrepancy logged for review.

structured_data.north_star: Frequent safe releases with low defect escape, controlled technical debt and clear rollback paths.

The knowledge must identify the business purpose, owners, inputs, outputs, evidence, decision thresholds, failure conditions and downstream effects. It must preserve the department charter — Build and safely evolve the QuotesDone product through maintainable architecture, tested changes, secure integrations and reliable releases. — and contribute to the north-star outcome: Frequent safe releases with low defect escape, controlled technical debt and clear rollback paths. Knowledge records should distinguish stable policy from live operational facts and should point to live tables rather than copying values that change.

structured_data.north_star: Frequent safe releases with low defect escape, controlled technical debt and clear rollback paths.

title: Security-By-Design — how the department uses it
content: When work involves security-by-design, the department should first establish the entity and workflow state, then retrieve current operational data, then apply the approved SOP and decision rules. The output must be structured for the next department rather than left as an informal narrative. The agent should identify what is known, what is inferred, what is missing and what evidence supports the conclusion. Repeated work should update reusable templates or rules only through the knowledge-change process.

structured_data.north_star: Frequent safe releases with low defect escape, controlled technical debt and clear rollback paths.

title: Security-By-Design — controls and boundaries
content: For security-by-design, the department must apply least privilege, data minimisation, audit logging, version control and the relevant authority tier. It must not treat a generated answer as proof. Where the topic affects legal rights, money, identity, privacy, security, production deployment or public claims, execution is blocked until the required approval and evidence are present. Conflicts between live data and static knowledge are resolved in favour of the authorised live source, with the discrepancy logged for review.

structured_data.north_star: Frequent safe releases with low defect escape, controlled technical debt and clear rollback paths.

title: Security-By-Design — evidence and live-data requirements
content: The department should prove work on security-by-design through the authoritative record for the entity, relevant documents, event history, approvals and outcome metrics. Candidate live sources include: implementation_map, integration_matrix, feature_flags, deploy_state, qd_deploy_src, qa_results, error_events, health_checks. Candidate execution evidence includes: put_src, push_src_to_github, github_sync, deploy_next_preview, site_deploy, qa_suite, os_health, backup. These names come from the supplied production export or the target design; Claude must map them to the current repository and schema, confirm permissions and record any mismatch instead of silently inventing a binding.

structured_data.north_star: Frequent safe releases with low defect escape, controlled technical debt and clear rollback paths.

Confirm the current workflow state, owner, service level and any open duplicate task.
Retrieve the minimum required live data and documents using least-privilege access.
Validate mandatory fields, evidence freshness, consent and applicable policy or jurisdiction.

title: Llms — operating knowledge
content: AI & Model Operations must understand LLMs as an operational capability, not as a generic definition. The knowledge must identify the business purpose, owners, inputs, outputs, evidence, decision thresholds, failure conditions and downstream effects. It must preserve the department charter — Design, evaluate, route and monitor models and agents so that deterministic logic is used where possible and expensive models are reserved for justified exceptions. — and contribute to the north-star outcome: High task accuracy at the lowest safe cost, with traceable model decisions and controlled autonomy. Knowledge records should distinguish stable policy from live operational facts and should point to live tables rather than copying values that change.

structured_data.north_star: High task accuracy at the lowest safe cost, with traceable model decisions and controlled autonomy.

title: Llms — how the department uses it
content: When work involves LLMs, the department should first establish the entity and workflow state, then retrieve current operational data, then apply the approved SOP and decision rules. The output must be structured for the next department rather than left as an informal narrative. The agent should identify what is known, what is inferred, what is missing and what evidence supports the conclusion. Repeated work should update reusable templates or rules only through the knowledge-change process.

structured_data.north_star: High task accuracy at the lowest safe cost, with traceable model decisions and controlled autonomy.

title: Llms — controls and boundaries
content: For LLMs, the department must apply least privilege, data minimisation, audit logging, version control and the relevant authority tier. It must not treat a generated answer as proof. Where the topic affects legal rights, money, identity, privacy, security, production deployment or public claims, execution is blocked until the required approval and evidence are present. Conflicts between live data and static knowledge are resolved in favour of the authorised live source, with the discrepancy logged for review.

structured_data.north_star: High task accuracy at the lowest safe cost, with traceable model decisions and controlled autonomy.

title: SOP 01 — User-Access Grant
content: This SOP governs user-access grant for IT, SRE & Cybersecurity. The department owns the workflow until the stated handoff is accepted by the next owner. Normal cases should progress without founder intervention; exceptions are escalated with evidence and a proposed resolution, not merely a problem statement.

structured_data.trigger: business event, scheduled control or authorised request
steps: Receive or detect the triggering event and assign a stable case or entity identifier.
Confirm the current workflow state, owner, service level and any open duplicate task.
Retrieve the minimum required live data and documents using least-privilege access.
Validate mandatory fields, evidence freshness, consent and applicable policy or jurisdiction.
Apply deterministic rules first; use an AI model only for language interpretation or an uncovered exception.
Produce the defined output in a structured format and attach evidence, assumptions, confidence and unresolved gaps.
If authority, confidence or evidence is insufficient, hold the action and create an escalation with a specific decision request.
Execute only within the department's authority tier and approved thresholds.
Record the action, result, downstream handoff and rollback reference in the audit trail.
Measure the outcome, close or retry the task, and propose a knowledge or process improvement when a recurring gap is found.
structured_data.service_level: Define in live department configuration; urgent legal, security and payment incidents use the incident SLA.
structured_data.rollback: Use versioned prior state, provider reversal, feature flag, task re-open or documented compensating action as appropriate.

title: IT, SRE & Cybersecurity rule 01 — Missing mandatory evidence
content: If a required document, field or provider event is absent, do not infer completion. Set the case to needs_information, request the exact missing evidence and suspend irreversible execution. The IT, SRE & Cybersecurity agent must record which rule fired, the relevant entity state and the downstream action.

structured_data.action: If routing or interpretation confidence is below the configured floor, ask one targeted clarification or route to the responsible specialist.

title: IT, SRE & Cybersecurity rule 03 — Live data conflicts with static knowledge
content: Treat the authoritative live record as operational truth, prevent execution if the conflict affects safety or rights, and create a knowledge-correction task. The IT, SRE & Cybersecurity agent must record which rule fired, the relevant entity state and the downstream action.

structured_data.action: Treat the authoritative live record as operational truth, prevent execution if the conflict affects safety or rights, and create a knowledge-correction task.

title: IT, SRE & Cybersecurity rule 04 — Duplicate task or event

title: IT, SRE & Cybersecurity rule 05 — Authority exceeded

structured_data.action: Block execution and request approval from the role specified in the authority matrix, including amount, impact, evidence and rollback plan.

title: IT, SRE & Cybersecurity rule 06 — Customer or supplier impact

structured_data.action: Before executing a material change, identify affected users, required notice, contractual or privacy implications and a remediation path.

title: IT, SRE & Cybersecurity rule 07 — Provider or integration unavailable
content: Queue recoverable work, switch only to approved fallback services, apply backoff, communicate service impact and reconcile after recovery. The IT, SRE & Cybersecurity agent must record which rule fired, the relevant entity state and the downstream action.

structured_data.action: Queue recoverable work, switch only to approved fallback services, apply backoff, communicate service impact and reconcile after recovery.

structured_data.action: Require two-step confirmation, evidence snapshot, explicit scope and legal or data-owner review where applicable.

title: IT, SRE & Cybersecurity rule 09 — Policy ambiguity

title: SOP 01 — Category Creation
content: This SOP governs category creation for Supplier Knowledge. The department owns the workflow until the stated handoff is accepted by the next owner. Normal cases should progress without founder intervention; exceptions are escalated with evidence and a proposed resolution, not merely a problem statement.

structured_data.trigger: business event, scheduled control or authorised request
steps: Receive or detect the triggering event and assign a stable case or entity identifier.
Confirm the current workflow state, owner, service level and any open duplicate task.
Retrieve the minimum required live data and documents using least-privilege access.
Validate mandatory fields, evidence freshness, consent and applicable policy or jurisdiction.
Apply deterministic rules first; use an AI model only for language interpretation or an uncovered exception.
Produce the defined output in a structured format and attach evidence, assumptions, confidence and unresolved gaps.
If authority, confidence or evidence is insufficient, hold the action and create an escalation with a specific decision request.
Execute only within the department's authority tier and approved thresholds.
Record the action, result, downstream handoff and rollback reference in the audit trail.
Measure the outcome, close or retry the task, and propose a knowledge or process improvement when a recurring gap is found.
structured_data.service_level: Define in live department configuration; urgent legal, security and payment incidents use the incident SLA.
structured_data.rollback: Use versioned prior state, provider reversal, feature flag, task re-open or documented compensating action as appropriate.

title: Document Classification — operating knowledge
content: Document Intelligence must understand document classification as an operational capability, not as a generic definition. The knowledge must identify the business purpose, owners, inputs, outputs, evidence, decision thresholds, failure conditions and downstream effects. It must preserve the department charter — Classify, extract, validate, compare, redact and version documents so information can move safely into operational workflows. — and contribute to the north-star outcome: Uploaded files become trustworthy structured data with preserved lineage, version and privacy controls. Knowledge records should distinguish stable policy from live operational facts and should point to live tables rather than copying values that change.

structured_data.north_star: Uploaded files become trustworthy structured data with preserved lineage, version and privacy controls.

title: Document Classification — how the department uses it
content: When work involves document classification, the department should first establish the entity and workflow state, then retrieve current operational data, then apply the approved SOP and decision rules. The output must be structured for the next department rather than left as an informal narrative. The agent should identify what is known, what is inferred, what is missing and what evidence supports the conclusion. Repeated work should update reusable templates or rules only through the knowledge-change process.

structured_data.north_star: Uploaded files become trustworthy structured data with preserved lineage, version and privacy controls.

title: Document Classification — controls and boundaries
content: For document classification, the department must apply least privilege, data minimisation, audit logging, version control and the relevant authority tier. It must not treat a generated answer as proof. Where the topic affects legal rights, money, identity, privacy, security, production deployment or public claims, execution is blocked until the required approval and evidence are present. Conflicts between live data and static knowledge are resolved in favour of the authorised live source, with the discrepancy logged for review.

structured_data.north_star: Uploaded files become trustworthy structured data with preserved lineage, version and privacy controls.

title: Document Classification — evidence and live-data requirements
content: The department should prove work on document classification through the authoritative record for the entity, relevant documents, event history, approvals and outcome metrics. steps: Receive or detect the triggering event and assign a stable case or entity identifier.

Retrieve the minimum required live data and documents using least-privilege access.
Validate mandatory fields, evidence freshness, consent and applicable policy or jurisdiction.
Apply deterministic rules first; use an AI model only for language interpretation or an uncovered exception.
Produce the defined output in a structured format and attach evidence, assumptions, confidence and unresolved gaps.

Execute only within the department's authority tier and approved thresholds.
Record the action, result, downstream handoff and rollback reference in the audit trail.

title: Email Operations — operating knowledge
content: Notification & Communications must understand email operations as an operational capability, not as a generic definition. The knowledge must identify the business purpose, owners, inputs, outputs, evidence, decision thresholds, failure conditions and downstream effects. It must preserve the department charter — Deliver accurate, consent-aware, traceable and resilient communications through email, WhatsApp, SMS, push and in-app messaging. — and contribute to the north-star outcome: Critical messages are delivered once, through the correct channel, with suppression, consent and audit controls. Knowledge records should distinguish stable policy from live operational facts and should point to live tables rather than copying values that change.

structured_data.north_star: Critical messages are delivered once, through the correct channel, with suppression, consent and audit controls.

title: Email Operations — how the department uses it
content: When work involves email operations, the department should first establish the entity and workflow state, then retrieve current operational data, then apply the approved SOP and decision rules. The output must be structured for the next department rather than left as an informal narrative. The agent should identify what is known, what is inferred, what is missing and what evidence supports the conclusion. Repeated work should update reusable templates or rules only through the knowledge-change process.

structured_data.north_star: Critical messages are delivered once, through the correct channel, with suppression, consent and audit controls.

title: Email Operations — controls and boundaries
content: For email operations, the department must apply least privilege, data minimisation, audit logging, version control and the relevant authority tier. It must not treat a generated answer as proof. Where the topic affects legal rights, money, identity, privacy, security, production deployment or public claims, execution is blocked until the required approval and evidence are present. Conflicts between live data and static knowledge are resolved in favour of the authorised live source, with the discrepancy logged for review.

structured_data.north_star: Critical messages are delivered once, through the correct channel, with suppression, consent and audit controls.

content: When work involves provider outage, the department should first establish the entity and workflow state, then retrieve current operational data, then apply the approved SOP and decision rules. The output must be structured for the next department rather than left as an informal narrative. The agent should identify what is known, what is inferred, what is missing and what evidence supports the conclusion. Repeated work should update reusable templates or rules only through the knowledge-change process.

title: Provider Outage — controls and boundaries
content: For provider outage, the department must apply least privilege, data minimisation, audit logging, version control and the relevant authority tier. It must not treat a generated answer as proof. Where the topic affects legal rights, money, identity, privacy, security, production deployment or public claims, execution is blocked until the required approval and evidence are present. Conflicts between live data and static knowledge are resolved in favour of the authorised live source, with the discrepancy logged for review.

structured_data.north_star: Every payment state is accurate, reconcilable and recoverable without exposing secrets or moving funds outside authority.

title: Provider Outage — evidence and live-data requirements

title: SOP 01 — Signup Risk Screening
content: This SOP governs signup risk screening for Trust & Safety. The department owns the workflow until the stated handoff is accepted by the next owner. Normal cases should progress without founder intervention; exceptions are escalated with evidence and a proposed resolution, not merely a problem statement.

structured_data.trigger: business event, scheduled control or authorised request
steps: Receive or detect the triggering event and assign a stable case or entity identifier.
Confirm the current workflow state, owner, service level and any open duplicate task.
Retrieve the minimum required live data and documents using least-privilege access.
Validate mandatory fields, evidence freshness, consent and applicable policy or jurisdiction.
Apply deterministic rules first; use an AI model only for language interpretation or an uncovered exception.
Produce the defined output in a structured format and attach evidence, assumptions, confidence and unresolved gaps.
If authority, confidence or evidence is insufficient, hold the action and create an escalation with a specific decision request.
Execute only within the department's authority tier and approved thresholds.
Record the action, result, downstream handoff and rollback reference in the audit trail.
Measure the outcome, close or retry the task, and propose a knowledge or process improvement when a recurring gap is found.
structured_data.service_level: Define in live department configuration; urgent legal, security and payment incidents use the incident SLA.
structured_data.rollback: Use versioned prior state, provider reversal, feature flag, task re-open or documented compensating action as appropriate.

title: Trust & Safety rule 01 — Missing mandatory evidence
content: If a required document, field or provider event is absent, do not infer completion. Set the case to needs_information, request the exact missing evidence and suspend irreversible execution. The Trust & Safety agent must record which rule fired, the relevant entity state and the downstream action.

structured_data.action: If a required document, field or provider event is absent, do not infer completion. Set the case to needs_information, request the exact missing evidence and suspend irreversible execution.

title: Trust & Safety rule 02 — Confidence below floor
content: If routing or interpretation confidence is below the configured floor, ask one targeted clarification or route to the responsible specialist. The Trust & Safety agent must record which rule fired, the relevant entity state and the downstream action.

structured_data.action: If routing or interpretation confidence is below the configured floor, ask one targeted clarification or route to the responsible specialist.

title: Trust & Safety rule 03 — Live data conflicts with static knowledge
content: Treat the authoritative live record as operational truth, prevent execution if the conflict affects safety or rights, and create a knowledge-correction task. The Trust & Safety agent must record which rule fired, the relevant entity state and the downstream action.

structured_data.condition: Live data conflicts with static knowledge
structured_data.action: Treat the authoritative live record as operational truth, prevent execution if the conflict affects safety or rights, and create a knowledge-correction task.

structured_data.action: Use the idempotency key and current entity state to suppress duplicate execution while preserving the duplicate event in the audit trail.

title: Company Core Knowledge — operating knowledge
content: Knowledge Engineering & Corporate Learning must understand company core knowledge as an operational capability, not as a generic definition. The knowledge must identify the business purpose, owners, inputs, outputs, evidence, decision thresholds, failure conditions and downstream effects. It must preserve the department charter — Maintain layered company knowledge, institutional memory, learning, source lineage, reviews and role certification across every department. — and contribute to the north-star outcome: Employees and agents answer from current, cited knowledge and the company preserves lessons across time. Knowledge records should distinguish stable policy from live operational facts and should point to live tables rather than copying values that change.

structured_data.north_star: Employees and agents answer from current, cited knowledge and the company preserves lessons across time.

title: Company Core Knowledge — how the department uses it
content: When work involves company core knowledge, the department should first establish the entity and workflow state, then retrieve current operational data, then apply the approved SOP and decision rules. The output must be structured for the next department rather than left as an informal narrative. The agent should identify what is known, what is inferred, what is missing and what evidence supports the conclusion. Repeated work should update reusable templates or rules only through the knowledge-change process.

structured_data.north_star: Employees and agents answer from current, cited knowledge and the company preserves lessons across time.

title: Company Core Knowledge — controls and boundaries
content: For company core knowledge, the department must apply least privilege, data minimisation, audit logging, version control and the relevant authority tier. It must not treat a generated answer as proof. Where the topic affects legal rights, money, identity, privacy, security, production deployment or public claims, execution is blocked until the required approval and evidence are present. Conflicts between live data and static knowledge are resolved in favour of the authorised live source, with the discrepancy logged for review.

structured_data.north_star: Employees and agents answer from current, cited knowledge and the company preserves lessons across time.

title: Company Core Knowledge — evidence and live-data requirements

title: Continuous Improvement — operating knowledge
content: Strategy, Performance & Evolution must understand continuous improvement as an operational capability, not as a generic definition. The knowledge must identify the business purpose, owners, inputs, outputs, evidence, decision thresholds, failure conditions and downstream effects. It must preserve the department charter — Continuously improve company design, cost, workflows, capabilities and outcomes using measured experiments and controlled change. — and contribute to the north-star outcome: The company becomes measurably more effective, reliable and cost-efficient each month. Knowledge records should distinguish stable policy from live operational facts and should point to live tables rather than copying values that change.

structured_data.north_star: The company becomes measurably more effective, reliable and cost-efficient each month.

title: Continuous Improvement — how the department uses it
content: When work involves continuous improvement, the department should first establish the entity and workflow state, then retrieve current operational data, then apply the approved SOP and decision rules. The output must be structured for the next department rather than left as an informal narrative. The agent should identify what is known, what is inferred, what is missing and what evidence supports the conclusion. Repeated work should update reusable templates or rules only through the knowledge-change process.

structured_data.north_star: The company becomes measurably more effective, reliable and cost-efficient each month.

title: Continuous Improvement — controls and boundaries
content: For continuous improvement, the department must apply least privilege, data minimisation, audit logging, version control and the relevant authority tier. It must not treat a generated answer as proof. Where the topic affects legal rights, money, identity, privacy, security, production deployment or public claims, execution is blocked until the required approval and evidence are present. Conflicts between live data and static knowledge are resolved in favour of the authorised live source, with the discrepancy logged for review.

structured_data.north_star: The company becomes measurably more effective, reliable and cost-efficient each month.
